product.name: Fundraising Service
product.description: A service that supports startup founders by managing routine fundraising tasks and providing assistance throughout the fundraising process.

product.name: Investor Outreach Service
product.description: A service that manages investor communications, schedules meetings, and facilitates warm introductions to potential investors.

product.name: Investor Relations Service
product.description: A service focused on managing ongoing investor communications, including updates, CRM management, and preparation of investor materials.

product.name: Fundraising Playbook
product.description: A comprehensive guide designed to assist CEOs in navigating the entire fundraising process.
